subject: permissionless-mining-strategy

metrics.principle: measure everything permissionlessly, publish signed cards, let verification be the product

what_we_mine_permissionlessly.stablecoins: attestation gaps, reserve staleness, buffer changes — no permission needed
what_we_mine_permissionlessly.xrpl_amendments: on-chain voting, amendment status, compliance scores — public blockchain
what_we_mine_permissionlessly.regulatory_filings: public comment submissions, published regulations — public record
what_we_mine_permissionlessly.model_releases: HuggingFace cards, model specs, license changes — public repos
what_we_mine_permissionlessly.supply_chain: deps.dev, OSV.dev, npm, PyPI — public registries
what_we_mine_permissionlessly.government_data: UK OGL, US public domain, EU open data — open licenses

automation_pipeline.firehose: GDELT, deps.dev, OSV.dev, GH Archive, government data → auto-ingest
automation_pipeline.card_gen: SOV3 autonomous brain → auto-generate measurement cards

metrics.significance: Permissionless mining = moat. Nobody else measures with signed, anchored, verifiable cards.

honest_sentence: Permissionless mining: measure stablecoins, XRPL, regulations, models, supply chain, market data, government data — all public, no permission needed. Owner gates: NIST/W3C/BSI/production-signing/Stripe/npm. Automation: firehose → card → quality → RSS → IndexNow.32 cron jobs. Nobody else does this.
